hero.subtitleLead: A new perspective on face and body care.
hero.subtitleBody1: At Palazzo, we have built a world dedicated to phyto-aesthetics — where formulas inspired by the potential of plants, the tradition of the Galenic Cataplasm and specialised care rituals come together in a personalised experience.
hero.subtitleBody2: From facial experiences created for your skin's needs, to body rituals dedicated to care, toning and wellbeing, through to treatments applied to carefully selected areas, focused on relaxation, easing discomfort and releasing tension.

intro.lead: Care doesn't begin with a procedure. It begins with you.
intro.belief: At Palazzo, we don't believe in identical experiences for every person.
intro.change: Skin changes. The body changes. Needs change. That is why every experience begins with understanding what you need in that moment.
intro.heading: PHYTOAESTHETICS, THE PALAZZO WAY
intro.definition: Phyto-aesthetics is how we see care — through an approach where the potential of plant-based ingredients, specialised formulations and application techniques come together in rituals created for face and body.
intro.closing: We don't set out to turn beauty into a standard formula.

values.attention: We care for it with attention

services.descBody: Every Palazzo experience begins with the same philosophy: a careful, personalised approach, where plant-based ingredients, specialised formulations and the way they are applied are chosen according to each person's needs. This philosophy takes different forms.
services.faceDesc:
Every skin is different. That is why our facial phyto-aesthetic experiences do not start from a standard approach, but from the needs, appearance and particularities of your skin.
At the heart of the FACE universe lies Re-GEN — a facial care concept that brings together specialized formulas, carefully selected ingredients and integrated techniques in an experience designed to support hydration, revitalization and the balanced appearance of the skin.
services.bodyDesc:
At Palazzo, body experiences start from a simple perspective: the appearance of the skin is influenced by more than what is visible on the surface.
That is why our rituals combine carefully integrated manual techniques with specialized phyto-aesthetic formulas and ingredients selected for their ability to support the care of skin tone, compactness and appearance.
From rituals dedicated to areas that need more attention, to experiences that focus on activation, drainage and relaxation, each procedure is built as a moment in which the body receives the time and care it needs.
services.impaccoDesc:
Tension accumulates. The body contracts. Certain areas remain overworked more than we realize.
Inspired by the tradition of Galenical Cataplasm, Impacco is a localized experience created for carefully selected areas, where heat, plants and action time meet in a ritual with its own identity.
Through its traditional counter-irritant action, the Cataplasm creates intense local activation accompanied by a progressive sensation of heat and the stimulation of microcirculation. The occlusive application contributes to maintaining the necessary conditions for the ingredients in the formula to act over time, transforming each Impacco into a profound and personal experience.
services.phytoaesteticaDesc: Customised phyto-aesthetic programmes and products developed through over 65 years of experience and research into the beneficial properties of medicinal plants. Treatments that leave your skin radiant, rejuvenated and toned and visibly reduce the signs of cellulite — all while you relax.
services.phytotherapyDesc: The healing properties of officinal herbs, harnessed in treatments and care rituals for body and mind. Our signature herbal compress and natural extracts work gently with your body to soothe inflammation, restore balance and support lasting, everyday wellbeing.
services.trialDesc: Book an appointment and experience one of our treatments first-hand.

AboutPage.title: About us
AboutPage.lead: Everything begins with the Cataplasma Galenica. Palazzo brings to Chișinău a tradition born in Italy in 1956 — a philosophy of care built around the potential of plants, research and care for each person.

story.heading: Our story
story.body1: At the heart of the Palazzo philosophy lies a concept rooted in a tradition developed in Italy almost seven decades ago.
story.body2: The Galenic Cataplasm was created in 1956 by Dr. Leone Zanellato and has become, over the years, the starting point of an approach built around the potential of plants, research and experience gained through continuous application and development.
story.body3: The formula brings together plant-based ingredients in a composition designed for local application. Ozonized oils are an important element of the concept, helping to create a favourable environment for the absorption of active ingredients into the skin and supporting the natural processes of microcirculation and oxygenation.
story.body4: More than a simple application on the skin, the Galenic Cataplasm turns formula, time and method of application into a single experience. A concept where tradition meets a new perspective on care.
story.body5: Today that same conviction guides everything we do: modern methods, natural remedies and the dedication with which we accompany each person towards lasting results.

who.heading: Who we are
who.body1: We are the team carrying this concept forward in Chișinău — aesthetic and phytotherapy specialists united by the same discipline of care: time, attention and consistency for each person.
who.body2: At Palazzo, every plan starts from the person, not from a template. We listen, observe and build a personal journey together — with modern methods, natural remedies and real presence, step by step.

description.heading: What is phyto-esthetics?
description.body1: Phyto-esthetics harnesses the beneficial properties of medicinal plants in customised aesthetic programmes and products, developed through more than 65 years of experience and research.
description.body2: At Palazzo, our specialised staff is at your disposal to design your personalised programme — only the excellence of nature and science, to make you feel better inside and appreciate yourself more outside.

helps.heading: How phyto-esthetics helps
helps.body: The time spent pampering yourself is never wasted: every treatment combines deep relaxation with visible results, working gently with your skin and body.
helps.point1: Restores radiant, rejuvenated and toned skin.
helps.point2: Visibly reduces the signs of cellulite.
helps.point3: Firms and sculpts the silhouette with plant-based care.
helps.point4: Lets you unwind completely while the treatment works.

treatments.heading: PhytoTreatments
treatments.subtitle: A complete path to natural beauty — from consultation to treatment, nutrition and mindset.

consultation.label: Consultation
consultation.title: Initial Physio-Aesthetic Consultation
consultation.p1: Physio-aesthetics arises from the union of physiotherapy and aesthetic medicine, in order to identify and treat the conditions that cause skin imperfections. Unlike aesthetics, which acts on the skin only from the outside, it intervenes in the physiological functions of the body to give it a natural beauty.
consultation.p2: Wellness is restored through advanced non-invasive treatments and exclusive phytotherapeutic products with slimming, anti-cellulite, toning, anti-aging and draining effects.

cellularReactivation.label: Cellular reactivation
cellularReactivation.h1: Phytotherapy cellular reactivation for the Face
cellularReactivation.p1: In December 2022 we launched the new Re-GEN Face Mask.
cellularReactivation.p2: Our Galenic Cataplasm, adapted for facial skin and enriched with anti-aging active ingredients, is the basis of the product. It is spread on an elegant golden silicone mask that adapts to every face shape.
cellularReactivation.p3: Scientific tests have shown its ability to stimulate cell turnover, eliminate dead cells, slow aging, tone tissues and smooth wrinkles, drain and deflate the bags under the eyes, and capture the free radicals that dull the complexion and cause impurities. The active ingredients penetrate deep into the layers of the skin thanks to ozonisation, a special processing technique developed in our laboratories.
cellularReactivation.p4: Your skin will be regenerated in just one hour!
cellularReactivation.h2: Phytotherapy cellular reactivation for the Body
cellularReactivation.p5: Our exclusive Galenic Cataplasm Compress was created in 1956 and has been constantly improved ever since. It is our flagship treatment, combining a healing effect with aesthetic improvement.
cellularReactivation.p6: The Compress has a powerful anti-inflammatory action, promoting cellular reactivation, the absorption of the body fluids that cause water retention, and the reduction of localised fat in critical areas.
cellularReactivation.p7: The result? Detoxified tissues, toned skin and visibly reduced blemishes.

lymphaticDrainage.label: Lymphatic Drainage
lymphaticDrainage.title: Advanced Manual Lymphatic Drainage
lymphaticDrainage.p1: A special type of physiotherapy massage whose manoeuvres boost or reactivate proper lymphatic circulation and eliminate excess interstitial fluid.
lymphaticDrainage.p2: Thanks to a specialisation course in Advanced Manual Lymphatic Drainage, our physiotherapists can effectively use three different techniques according to the patient's needs: the Leduc, Vodder and Belgrade techniques.
lymphaticDrainage.p3: The ultimate goal is to restore the person's psychophysical well-being, acting at the root of medical issues with aesthetic implications such as cellulite, water retention, swelling, lymphoedema, lipoedema and circulatory failure. It also helps you eliminate drug residues and food toxins and strengthens your immune system.

posturalReeducation.label: Postural re-education
posturalReeducation.p1: A frequent mistake is to underestimate the influence of posture on the proper functioning of the body and on its imperfections, such as cellulite and abdominal bloating.
posturalReeducation.p2: Through targeted postural re-education, the goal is to bring the body back to a state of overall well-being.

nutrition.label: Nutrition
nutrition.p1: We will lead you to your ideal diet and supplementation plan through an innovative path — without imposed fasting, calorie counting or complicated recipes.
nutrition.p2: Our modern approach is suitable for those who have little time but do not want to give up a healthy diet.

personalTraining.label: Personal Training
personalTraining.p1: With a background in competitive sports and qualifications as both an instructor and a specialised physiotherapist, our personal trainer will create an effective, personalised training plan tailored to your needs.
personalTraining.p2: Working together, you'll find the physical activity that best suits your lifestyle, taking into account your schedule and personal preferences.

mentalCoaching.label: Mental Coaching
mentalCoaching.p1: A key factor in any wellness journey is maintaining a positive mindset towards eating habits and body image. That's why your journey is guided by a certified Mindfulness Facilitator.
mentalCoaching.p2: Throughout your journey, you'll receive support and motivation whenever you face challenges or uncertainties. Through these sessions, you'll develop a healthy and mindful relationship with both food and your body.

description.heading: What is Impacco?
description.body1: Impacco is the therapeutic use of plants and their active compounds to prevent and treat illness — one of the oldest forms of medicine, refined by modern science.
description.body2: At Palazzo, we pair traditional botanical knowledge with current research to create natural remedies that complement your care, support recovery and strengthen your body's own balance.

helps.heading: How Impacco helps
helps.body: Plant-based therapy works with your body rather than against it, offering gentle, effective support for a wide range of everyday concerns.
helps.point1: Calms inflammation with potent natural compounds.
helps.point2: Supports the immune system and overall vitality.
helps.point3: Supports the body's natural recovery and regeneration.
helps.point4: Promotes relaxation, better sleep and balance.

benefits.heading: The benefits you'll feel
benefits.subtitle: What Impacco at Palazzo gives you, naturally.

muscleJoint.label: Muscle-joint
muscleJoint.p1: Joints are frequently affected by rheumatism; it is estimated that over 5 million people worldwide suffer from it. Rheumatism generally refers to an inflammatory state of the joints and their structures which, in its most advanced stage, also affects tissues and internal organs.
muscleJoint.p2: Arthritis and arthrosis are two different types of rheumatism. Arthrosis is the most common form: it is caused by the progressive degeneration of the cartilage that protects the bones of the joints and causes pain that becomes increasingly disabling over time. There is a clear genetic predisposition, but it manifests itself under external influences such as viruses, bacteria, mechanical stress and hormonal factors. Arthritis, on the other hand, is the inflammation of the joint itself, which can occur at any age.
muscleJoint.p3: The anti-inflammatory, muscle-relaxant and vasodilatory action of our Galenic Cataplasm brings rapid relief in these cases.
muscleJoint.p4: The Cataplasm Compress helps gradually reduce joint inflammation, promotes self-repair of damaged tissue through cellular renewal, and lubricates worn cartilage thanks to improved vascularisation. Moreover, the highly pure active ingredients extracted from medicinal plants reduce the oedema caused by rheumatism, which would otherwise lead to stiffness and pain during movement.

neurological.label: Neurological
neurological.p1: Among the problems related to the spine, we successfully treat various types of neuralgia caused by neuritis and radiculitis.
neurological.p2: Neuritis is the inflammation of the myelin sheath that protects the nerve. It can be triggered by disc problems, such as hernias and protrusions, which under certain conditions compress the nerve root and generate pain. The anti-inflammatory action of the Compress brings the disc tissue back to a healthy state, increasing hydration and reducing the inflammation of the affected nerve endings. It also acts on the myelin sheath, nourishing it and restoring it to normal.
neurological.p3: As always, it is best to intervene as soon as one of the symptoms appears, to quickly relieve the acute pain and prevent the possible damage caused by these problems. Our treatment will improve your quality of life, without having to ease the discomfort with NSAIDs or being forced into complete rest of the affected area.

respiratory.label: Respiratory
respiratory.p1: The active ingredients contained in our Galenic Cataplasm act on inflamed or hypertrophic mucous membranes, improving tissue oxygenation and respiratory function. At the same time, the antiseptic and mucolytic effect of the Compress counteracts the action of viruses and bacteria and quickly thins the mucus and phlegm of the respiratory system.
respiratory.p2: This natural treatment can also be applied to children.

circulatory.label: Circulatory
circulatory.p1: Our Compress works by increasing the blood supply to the lower limbs; this vascularisation effectively activates both the lymphatic system and blood microcirculation, draining excess fluid and eliminating toxins. The unaesthetic effects of water retention are visibly reduced, and the legs immediately feel less swollen and lighter.
circulatory.p2: Its anti-inflammatory property acts on inflamed veins, successfully treating varicose veins and phlebitis.
circulatory.p3: Finally, the antibacterial action of the Cataplasm prevents the formation of lesions in the most severe cases or, if they are already present, fights infections and encourages their healing.

visceral.label: Visceral
visceral.p1: Years of use of our patented Compress have allowed us to confirm its effectiveness at the visceral level as well. The internal organs benefit from the phytotherapeutic principles of the Cataplasm, absorbed through the skin when applied to the abdomen.
visceral.p2: This beneficial effect comes from the oxygenation of the blood, which produces a detoxifying action on the internal organs, but also from the anti-inflammatory and muscle-relaxing properties — useful in cases of inflammation, infections, cramps and abdominal pain (e.g. colitis and gastritis).

cutaneous.label: Cutaneous
cutaneous.p1: Skin problems often bring discomfort and embarrassment to those who suffer from them, at any age. Thanks to our Galenic Cataplasm Compress, we have helped hundreds of teenagers — and not only them — overcome these difficulties, by addressing the root of the problem rather than just its surface.
cutaneous.p2: Its action deeply reduces inflammation of the affected area and prevents new outbreaks thanks to its antibacterial properties, while also soothing the scars these conditions sometimes leave on the skin. The nourishment combined with the anti-inflammatory action cleanses the follicles, and the strengthened microcirculation oxygenates the dermis, leaving the skin glowing. The overall result is a clear, visible and lasting improvement.

issues.heading: Issues treated successfully
issues.subtitle: A selection of the conditions our Galenic Cataplasm Compress has proven effective on.

shoulder.title: Shoulder problems
shoulder.desc: The shoulder, like the other joints of the body, can be affected by rheumatism, arthrosis and arthritis, which cause annoying pain and stiffness in daily movements.

knee.title: Knee problems
knee.desc: The application of our Compress is helpful in case of knee problems, particularly of the meniscus or patella, and after the surgical implantation of a prosthesis — both to ease the pain and to promote an effective post-surgical recovery.

handElbow.title: Hand and elbow problems
handElbow.desc: Carpal tunnel syndrome is a widespread issue that we often treat. It is caused by chronic inflammation of the tendon lining of the flexors, which compresses the median nerve.

foot.title: Foot problems
foot.desc: Among the foot problems we have been treating effectively for many years are: sports traumas (e.g. strains), hallux valgus, inflammation of the metatarsus, plantar fasciitis and heel spur.

neuralgia.title: Neuralgia and radiculitis
neuralgia.desc: Radiculitis is the initial stage of neuritis. It arises from an inflammatory process at the root of a nerve.

spine.title: Spine problems
spine.desc: The problems patients have most frequently reported to us in almost 70 years of activity are: back pain caused by acute lumbago, protrusions and hernias.

respiratory.title: Diseases of the respiratory system
respiratory.desc: From the most common cold and cough to rhinitis, sinusitis and bronchitis, the Compress is a great ally to prevent them or treat them quickly.

circulatory.title: Circulatory failure
circulatory.desc: Changes in the blood and lymphatic systems lead to fluid stagnation, resulting in swollen legs and ankles and a feeling of heaviness.

skin.title: Skin problems
skin.desc: Our face is our calling card, which is why issues such as dermatitis, psoriasis, acne and rosacea often cause discomfort and embarrassment at any age.

abdominal.title: Abdominal pain
abdominal.desc: Thanks to the abdominal Compress, the liver is detoxified, the intestines work more effectively, and the disabling pain caused by conditions such as endometriosis is significantly reduced; the discomfort of colitis, gastritis or menstrual pain is equally relieved by the muscle-relaxant effect.
